cases.intent: Maintain possession and progress through the central corridor.
cases.setup: Play 6v6 with two 18 m (20 yd) end zones at either end of a 40 x 30 m (44 x 33 yd) area. A central corridor runs through the middle of the field. Teams start in their defensive half, and possession begins with a pass from the defensive end. Play restarts from the defensive end after a score or ball out of play. Mark a line across the pitch beyond the first defenders. Start each attack from your goalkeeper or a restart in your own half.
rules: If possession is lost, the opposing team starts from their defensive end.
Keep the ball and work it forward under pressure. Force it or lose it and the other team attacks straight away. Play does not stop.
cases.scoring: Start each attack from your goalkeeper or a restart in your own half. Earn a point when a player dribbles over the line, or receives the ball past it and controls it. A long kick that lands past the line does not count. Points are worth most through the middle, then wide, then deep.

cases.intent: React quickly to transitions and maintain possession.

cases.scoring: Start each attack from your goalkeeper or a restart in your own half. Earn a point when a player dribbles into the target zone, or receives the ball there and controls it. A long kick into the target zone does not count.

cases.intent: Deny attackers space in wide channels and regain possession quickly.
cases.setup: Play in a 40 x 30 m (44 x 33 yd) field with two 18 m (20 yd) wide channels on each side. Teams of 5v5 with a neutral player in each channel. Defenders protect the central space while attackers aim to exploit the wide channels. Play starts with a pass from the coach to any player, and restarts from the coach after a score or ball out of play. Mark an escape line across the pitch for each team to attack. Every time a team loses the ball, count to five out loud.
rules: Attackers aim to move the ball into wide channels to create scoring chances.
Defenders focus on closing down space and regaining possession quickly.
Neutral players in channels can only play one-touch passes.
Whoever wins the ball attacks immediately. If the attack stalls or the ball is lost, the other team does the same. Play does not stop.
A regain only counts if your team plays forward with the next action. Win it and give it straight back and it does not count.
cases.scoring: When your team loses the ball, count to five out loud. Earn a point if you win it back before you reach five. Points are worth most through the middle, then wide, then deep.
